briefing: Huawei was convicted of conspiracy to steal trade secrets but cleared of racketeering, and the US is probing Iran ties to up to 50 hacked ships. Anthropic shares fell below their $83 IPO price, and Nvidia gave back part of its rally. Sanofi agreed to buy Insmed for $41 billion. In Idaho, a federal scorecard ranks the state first for foster homes per child.
